title: ComputerSD: Online Self-Distillation from Real-Time Feedback for Computer-Use Agents
title_zh: ComputerSD：面向计算机使用代理的实时反馈在线自蒸馏

paragraphs.en: Online training enables computer-use agents (CUAs) to improve through interaction with executable environments. However, existing methods primarily rely on sparse outcome rewards, which provide no supervision for intermediate actions. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) offers token-level learning signals through privileged rescoring, but directly applying it to CUA online training presents two challenges: fixed guidance may become misaligned with the student’s current state, and guidance-induced probability shifts may conflict with step-level correctness. We introduce ComputerSD , an online self-distillation method for CUAs that converts real-time feedback from executed GUI transitions into guidance for policy learning. A fine-tuned GUI analyzer produces guidance and a step-level value score after each action; the guidance provides privileged context, while the score regulates the resulting OPSD signals. ComputerSD jointly optimizes token-level OPSD and trajectory-level GRPO in a fully asynchronous training framework. On OSWorld-Verified, ComputerSD outperforms outcome-only GRPO by 1.9 and 4.1 percentage points on the general-purpose Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking and specialized EvoCUA-8B backbones, respectively. Evaluation in out-of-distribution settings further supports the generalizability of ComputerSD. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of learning from real-time feedback through online self-distillation for CUAs.
paragraphs.zh: 在线训练使计算机使用智能体（CUA）能够通过与可执行环境的互动得到提升。 然而，现有方法主要依赖稀疏的结果奖励，而这些奖励无法对中间动作提供任何监督。 策略内自蒸馏（OPSD）通过特权重评分提供词元级的学习信号，但将其直接应用于 CUA 在线训练存在两个挑战：固定的指导可能与学生的当前状态脱节，而指导引发的概率变化可能与步骤级正确性产生冲突。 我们提出了 ComputerSD，一种面向 CUA 的在线自蒸馏方法，它将从执行的 GUI 转换中获得的实时反馈转化为策略学习的指导。 经过微调的 GUI 分析器会在每个动作后生成指导信息和步骤级的价值评分；指导信息提供特权上下文，而评分则调节由此产生的 OPSD 信号。 ComputerSD 在一个完全异步的训练框架中，联合优化词元级的 OPSD 和轨迹级的 GRPO。 在 OSWorld-Verified 上，ComputerSD 在通用型 Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking 和专业型 EvoCUA-8B 基础模型上的表现分别比仅依赖结果的 GRPO 高出 1.9 和 4.1 个百分点。 在分布外设置中的评估进一步验证了 ComputerSD 的泛化能力。 这些结果表明，通过在线自蒸馏从实时反馈中学习对 CUA 是有效的。

paragraphs.en: Developing computer-use agents (CUAs) capable of operating graphical user interfaces (GUIs) is an essential step toward autonomous computer use ( Qin et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Xu et al., 2025 ) . To bridge the gap between offline demonstrations and real-world interaction, recent studies have increasingly turned to online training in interactive environments ( Wang et al., 2025a ; Zhou et al., 2025 ; Lai et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2025 ) . These methods rely primarily on outcome rewards produced by environment verifiers. Such rewards indicate whether a task is completed but not which of the many actions in an episode were productive, redundant, or erroneous, making credit assignment a persistent challenge in online CUA training ( Chen et al., 2025 ; Feng et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 开发能够操作图形用户界面（GUI）的计算机使用智能体（CUA），是迈向自主计算机使用的关键一步（Qin 等，2025；Wang 等，2025b；Xu 等，2025）。 为了弥合离线演示与真实世界交互之间的差距，近期的研究越来越多地转向在交互式环境中的在线训练（Wang 等，2025a；Zhou 等，2025；Lai 等，2026；Lu 等，2025）。 这些方法主要依赖由环境验证器生成的结果奖励。 这类奖励仅能表明任务是否完成，却无法说明某一回合中众多动作中哪些是有效的、冗余的或错误的，这使得信用分配成为在线 CUA 训练中的一个持续挑战（Chen 等，2025；Feng 等，2025）。

paragraphs.en: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD), recently extended to multi-turn agents ( Lu et al., 2026a ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026 ) , recovers this fine-grained credit at the token level ( Zhao et al., 2026 ; Hübotter et al., 2026 ) : the policy rescores its own sampled response under privileged information such as a reference trajectory or task-relevant skills ( Wang et al., 2026a ; Lu et al., 2026b ) , and the resulting log-probability shifts serve as supervision on which tokens to reinforce or suppress.
paragraphs.zh: 在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）最近已扩展至多轮智能体（Lu et al., 2026a；Yang et al., 2026；Wu et al., 2026），该方法在词元层面恢复了这种精细的信用分配（Zhao et al., 2026；Hübotter et al., 2026）：策略基于参考轨迹或任务相关技能等特权信息，对其自身采样的响应进行重新评分（Wang et al., 2026a；Lu et al., 2026b），而由此产生的对数概率变化则作为监督信号，用以决定哪些词元需要强化或抑制。

paragraphs.en: Applying OPSD to online CUA training, however, raises two problems, illustrated in Figure 1 a. The first problem is that privileged information fixed before the rollout becomes misaligned with the student’s state. A CUA task usually admits multiple valid solutions, and once the student leaves the path that a reference trajectory or pre-written guidance assumes, the guidance no longer matches the observed state ( Shenfeld et al., 2026 ; Harne et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026b ) . Distilling toward such guidance then suppresses the tokens of steps that are correct on the student’s own path (Figure 1 b). The second problem is that the token-level signals are unreliable even when the guidance is relevant. Guidance shifts the probability of every token in the response, and the shift at a given token need not agree with whether the step was correct: over 80% of tokens at correct steps are suppressed and nearly 20% of tokens at incorrect ones are reinforced throughout training (Figure 1 c). Without regulation, these signals would pull the policy away from the task objective.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，将 OPSD 应用于在线 CUA 训练会引发两个问题，如图 1 a 所示。 第一个问题是，在部署前固定的特权信息会与学生的状态出现错位。 CUA 任务通常存在多个有效解；一旦学生偏离参考轨迹或预设指导所假设的路径，该指导便不再与观测到的状态匹配（Shenfeld et al., 2026 ; Harne et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026b）。 因此，以这类指导为目标进行知识蒸馏会抑制学生在自身路径上正确步骤所对应的词元（图 1 b）。 第二个问题是，即使指导具有相关性，词元层面的信号仍然不可靠。 指导会改变响应中每个词元的概率，而某个特定词元的概率变化并不一定与该步骤是否正确一致：在整个训练过程中，超过 80% 正确步骤中的词元被抑制，而近 20% 错误步骤中的词元则被强化（图 1 c）。 若无约束机制，这些信号会将策略从任务目标中拉偏。

paragraphs.en: Our key insight is that the real-time observation after each action can resolve both problems at once. Once an action is executed, its consequence appears on the next screen, and feedback written from this transition, which we call real-time feedback , describes exactly the state the student reached and removes the misalignment. The same feedback can also judge whether the action was correct, so the signal that constructs the privileged context can also decide how far to trust the token-level supervision it induces . Recent work likewise conditions the teacher on the post-action observation ( Liu et al., 2026a ; Li et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026b ) , but stops at state matching, which still leaves the induced shifts unreliable. We additionally use the feedback’s own judgment of the step to regulate every token-level signal it produces.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的核心见解是，每次行动后的实时观察能够同时解决这两个问题。 一旦某个行动被执行，其结果就会出现在下一个屏幕上，而由这一转变产生的反馈（我们称之为实时反馈）会精确描述学生所达到的状态，并消除不一致性。 同样的反馈也可以判断该行动是否正确，因此构建特权上下文的信号也能决定对由此引发的词元级监督应有多大的信任度。 近期的研究同样将教师模型的条件建立在行动后的观察结果之上（Liu et al., 2026a; Li et al., 2026; Wang et al., 2026b），但仅止步于状态匹配，这仍然导致由此引发的变化不可靠。 我们还进一步利用反馈对当前步骤的判断来调节其产生的每一个词元级信号。

paragraphs.en: Building on this insight, we propose ComputerSD , an online self-distillation method that converts real-time feedback into value-gated token-level supervision (Figure 2 ). After each action, a GUI analyzer reads the screenshots before and after it and returns a step-level value score together with guidance on what to do and what to avoid from the pre-action state; since the untuned policy often misjudges GUI transitions, we fine-tune the analyzer on expert annotations. The guidance then serves as the privileged context for rescoring, and a value gate weights each token’s shift by its agreement with the value score. We optimize this token-level objective jointly with trajectory-level GRPO, so that step-level feedback refines credit within each episode while outcome rewards keep learning anchored to task success. To prevent per-step analysis from stalling rollout, we design a fully asynchronous pipeline for ComputerSD.
paragraphs.zh: 基于这一洞见，我们提出了 ComputerSD——一种在线自蒸馏方法，可将实时反馈转化为以价值为门控的令牌级监督（图 2）。 每次执行动作后，GUI 分析器会读取动作前后截屏，返回一个步骤级的价值评分，并提供关于应做什么和应避免什么的操作指导（基于动作前的状态）；由于未经调优的策略常对 GUI 转换做出误判，因此我们使用专家标注数据对该分析器进行微调。 随后，这些指导信息将作为特权上下文用于重新评分，而价值门控则根据各令牌与价值评分的一致性来调整其权重。 我们将这种令牌级目标与轨迹级的 GRPO 联合优化，使得步骤级反馈能在每个回合内完善信用分配，同时结果奖励仍确保学习始终锚定于任务成功。 为防止逐步骤分析导致推理过程停滞，我们为 ComputerSD 设计了一套完全异步的处理流程。

paragraphs.en: On OSWorld-Verified ( Xie et al., 2024 ) , ComputerSD outperforms outcome-only GRPO on both the general-purpose Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking ( Bai et al., 2025 ) and the computer-use model EvoCUA-8B ( Xue et al., 2026 ) , raising the success rate from 37.9% to 39.8% and from 43.8% to 47.9%. The gains are largest on application categories held out from training (from 21.6% to 27.5% and from 30.2% to 35.4%), indicating that the step-level supervision transfers beyond the training distribution. Ablations mirror the two failures identified above: either replacing real-time feedback with fixed guidance or removing the value gate drops performance below GRPO on Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking, demonstrating the necessity of our design. Finally, the asynchronous pipeline raises training throughput fivefold over its synchronous counterpart, keeping per-step feedback affordable.

sents.zh: 在训练数据中未包含的应用类别上，性能提升最为显著（从 21.6% 提升至 27.5%，以及从 30.2% 提升至 35.4%），这表明步骤级监督能够迁移到训练分布之外的场景。

sents.en: Ablations mirror the two failures identified above: either replacing real-time feedback with fixed guidance or removing the value gate drops performance below GRPO on Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking, demonstrating the necessity of our design.
sents.zh: 消融实验结果与上述两种失败情况一致：无论是用固定指导替代实时反馈，还是移除价值门控，都会导致 Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking 上的性能低于 GRPO，这证明了我们的设计是必要的。

sents.en: Finally, the asynchronous pipeline raises training throughput fivefold over its synchronous counterpart, keeping per-step feedback affordable.
sents.zh: 最后，异步流水线使训练吞吐量较同步版本提升了五倍，同时保持了每一步反馈的成本可控性。

paragraphs.en: Our main contributions are summarized as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 我们的主要贡献总结如下：

paragraphs.en: We propose ComputerSD, an online self-distillation method in which a fine-tuned GUI analyzer writes real-time feedback after each action and a value gate weights each token-level signal by its agreement with the analyzer’s judgment of the step.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 ComputerSD，一种在线自蒸馏方法：其中，一个经过微调的 GUI 分析器会在每次操作后生成实时反馈，而一个价值门则根据每个词元级信号与该分析器对当前步骤的判断的一致性程度来为其分配权重。

paragraphs.en: We develop a fully asynchronous training pipeline that overlaps environment interaction, GUI analysis, privileged rescoring, and policy optimization, so that rollout workers keep collecting trajectories while each executed step is analyzed and rescored.
paragraphs.zh: 我们开发了一种完全异步的训练流程，该流程将环境交互、GUI 分析、特权重评分和策略优化重叠进行，从而使得部署工人能够持续收集轨迹，同时每一步的执行过程都会被分析和重新评分。

paragraphs.en: We show on OSWorld-Verified with two 8B backbones with different levels of computer-use specialization that ComputerSD outperforms outcome-only GRPO, and that removing either real-time feedback or the value gate lowers performance below GRPO.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 OSWorld-Verified 上进行了验证，使用两个具有不同计算机使用专业化水平的 8B 基础模型发现，ComputerSD 的表现优于仅基于结果的 GRPO；而移除实时反馈或价值门限，都会导致性能低于 GRPO。

paragraphs.en: Recent CUAs improve by scaling verifiable training tasks ( Xue et al., 2026 ; Lv et al., 2026 ) and by online reinforcement learning in executable environments, where ComputerRL and UI-TARS-2 run rollouts over parallel environments ( Lai et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2025a ) and DART decouples rollout from training ( Li et al., 2025 ) . To supervise intermediate steps, GUI-Shepherd learns a process reward model ( Chen et al., 2025 ) and GiGPO estimates step-level advantages from repeated states ( Feng et al., 2025 ) ; both assign a single scalar to each step. ComputerSD instead turns the feedback on each executed step into token-level supervision, and its asynchronous pipeline overlaps this analysis with rollout and training.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的 CUAs 通过扩展可验证的训练任务（Xue et al., 2026；Lv et al., 2026）以及在可执行环境中进行在线强化学习而得到改进，其中 ComputerRL 和 UI-TARS-2 在并行环境中运行展开过程（Lai et al., 2026；Wang et al., 2025a），而 DART 则将展开过程与训练分离（Li et al., 2025）。 为了监督中间步骤，GUI-Shepherd 学习一个过程奖励模型（Chen et al., 2025），而 GiGPO 则从重复出现的状态中估计步骤级别的收益（Feng et al., 2025）；两者都为每个步骤分配一个单一的标量值。 相比之下，ComputerSD 将每一步执行后的反馈转化为词元级别的监督，其异步处理流程将此分析与展开过程和训练过程重叠进行。

paragraphs.en: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) obtains a teacher by conditioning the policy on privileged information and distills its token-level predictions on the policy’s own samples ( Agarwal et al., 2024 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ; Hübotter et al., 2026 ) . For multi-turn agents, OPID and SEED derive this information from completed trajectories ( Yang et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026 ) , and SDAR gates the resulting signals by the teacher–student gap ( Lu et al., 2026a ) . Because information fixed in advance can mismatch the states the student reaches, HERO conditions the teacher on a diagnosis of the observation after each action ( Liu et al., 2026a ) , and GHD and OpenClaw-RL bring this idea to GUI agents via the next screenshot and via hints from a prompted judge ( Li et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026b ) . ComputerSD obtains both the guidance and a step-level judgment from a fine-tuned GUI analyzer and gates each token-level signal by this judgment, a check at the level of the step rather than of the teacher–student gap or the trajectory outcome ( Lin et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: On-policy self-distillation（OPSD）通过将策略条件化于特权信息来生成一个教师模型，并基于策略自身的样本对其在词元层面的预测进行蒸馏（Agarwal 等，2024；Zhao 等，2026；Hübotter 等，2026）。 对于多轮智能体，OPID 和 SEED 从已完成的轨迹中获取这些信息（Yang 等，2026；Wu 等，2026），而 SDAR 则通过教师-学生模型之间的差距对生成的信号进行筛选（Lu 等，2026a）。 由于预先固定的信息可能与学生模型所达到的状态不匹配，HERO 将教师模型的生成条件化于每次行动后对观察结果的诊断（Liu 等，2026a），而 GHD 和 OpenClaw-RL 则通过下一张屏幕截图以及提示法官提供的线索，将这一思路应用于 GUI 智能体（Li 等，2026；Wang 等，2026b）。 ComputerSD 从经过微调的 GUI 分析器中同时获取指导信息和步骤层面的判断，并基于该判断对每个词元层面的信号进行筛选，这种检查发生在步骤层面，而非教师-学生模型之间的差距或轨迹结果层面（Lin 等，2026）。

paragraphs.en: We present ComputerSD , an online self-distillation method for computer-use agents. As illustrated in Figure 2 , ComputerSD first samples multiple trajectories through online interaction with parallel computer environments, followed by a GUI analyzer that provides step-level guidance based on the interaction process, which is then used to value-gate the token-level reward signals and control their strength according to the step-level value. Finally, the resulting token-level signals are combined with environment rewards to optimize the policy model.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 ComputerSD，一种面向计算机使用智能体的在线自蒸馏方法。 如图 2 所示，ComputerSD 首先通过与并行计算机环境的在线交互采样出多条轨迹，随后由一个 GUI 分析器根据交互过程提供步骤级指导，该指导接着被用于对词元级奖励信号进行价值门控，并根据步骤级价值控制其强度。 最后，将得到的词元级信号与环境奖励相结合，以优化策略模型。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 presents the performance of ComputerSD alongside representative proprietary and open-source models on OSWorld-Verified. For each backbone, we compare ComputerSD with outcome-only GRPO under the same online training and evaluation settings. The results show that ComputerSD outperforms GRPO on both backbones. On Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking, ComputerSD achieves a success rate of 39.8%, exceeding GRPO by 1.9 points. The gain is larger on the specialized model EvoCUA-8B, where ComputerSD reaches 47.9% and outperforms GRPO by 4.1 points. This further improvement suggests that token-level supervision derived from real-time guidance remains effective even after computer-use-specific post-training. Additionally, EvoCUA-8B trained with ComputerSD surpasses all listed open-source models and most listed proprietary models, demonstrating the effectiveness of ComputerSD.
paragraphs.zh: 表1展示了ComputerSD在OSWorld-Verified数据集上与部分代表性专有模型和开源模型的性能对比。 对于每个基础模型，我们在相同的在线训练和评估设置下，将ComputerSD与仅基于结果的GRPO进行了比较。 结果表明，ComputerSD在这两个基础模型上的表现均优于GRPO。 在Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking上，ComputerSD的成功率为39.8%，比GRPO高出1.9个百分点。 在专用模型EvoCUA-8B上，这一提升更为显著：ComputerSD达到了47.9%，比GRPO高出4.1个百分点。 这种进一步的提升表明，即便经过针对计算机使用场景的后续训练，源自实时指导的标记级监督仍然有效。 此外，使用ComputerSD训练的EvoCUA-8B超越了所有列出的开源模型以及大多数列出的专有模型，证明了ComputerSD的有效性。

paragraphs.en: We further evaluate generalization on the held-out categories of OSWorld-Verified and the cross-platform benchmark WindowsAgentArena (WAA). As shown in Table 2 , outcome-only GRPO improves in-domain performance but degrades most of the OOD performance relative to the base models on both backbones. In contrast, ComputerSD consistently improves in-domain and OOD performance on both backbones. On Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking, ComputerSD outperforms GRPO by 5.9 points on the held-out categories and 1.2 points on WAA. On EvoCUA-8B, the corresponding gains are 5.2 and 3.6 points, respectively. These results suggest that ComputerSD does not merely fit the training tasks but internalizes real-time feedback into the policy improvements that can generalize to unseen scenarios.

paragraphs.en: We examine how the performance of outcome-only GRPO and ComputerSD evolves throughout online training. As shown in Figure 4 , ComputerSD maintains higher success rates than outcome-only GRPO throughout most of the training process on both backbones. ComputerSD reaches the final GRPO performance after approximately 100 policy updates on Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking and 40 on EvoCUA-8B. With the same number of sampled trajectories per update, ComputerSD uses only about 56% and 22% of GRPO’s trajectory budget, respectively, to reach the same performance. This faster improvement suggests that real-time guidance helps the policy learn more from online interactions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究了仅基于结果的 GRPO 和 ComputerSD 的性能在整个在线训练过程中的演变情况。 如图 4 所示，在两种基础模型上，ComputerSD 在整个训练过程中大部分时间都保持了比仅基于结果的 GRPO 更高的成功率。 在 Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking 上，ComputerSD 经过大约 100 次策略更新后达到了最终的 GRPO 性能；而在 EvoCUA-8B 上则需要 40 次更新。 在每次更新采样轨迹数量相同的情况下，ComputerSD 分别仅使用了 GRPO 轨迹预算的约 56% 和 22%，便达到了相同的性能水平。 这种更快的改进表明，实时指导有助于策略从在线交互中学习到更多内容。

paragraphs.en: Replacing real-time feedback with fixed privileged guidance reduces the success rate by 4.8 percentage points. Fixed guidance can become misaligned with the agent’s actual state and may mislead it. paragraphs.en: Table 4 compares our value gate with three alternatives, showing that how OPSD signals are regulated substantially affects policy improvement. The SDAR gate ( Lu et al., 2026a ) consistently attenuates negative probability shifts for conservative token-level supervision. This can leave undesirable sampled actions insufficiently corrected, particularly when the student policy is weak, slowing improvement. The hard value gate replaces the sigmoid with a binary step function, removing signals that conflict with the step-level value judgment and assigning full weight to aligned signals. This aggressive filtering may overfit to the guidance-conditioned teacher distribution and impair generalization, yielding a 4.6-point drop in overall success rate.

paragraphs.en: We introduced ComputerSD, an online self-distillation method that converts real-time feedback from GUI transitions into policy updates for CUAs. A fine-tuned GUI analyzer produces guidance and a step-level value judgment from each executed action; the guidance supplies privileged context, while the value judgment gates the resulting token-level OPSD signals. ComputerSD combines this objective with trajectory-level GRPO and conducts online training in a fully asynchronous framework. On OSWorld-Verified, it outperforms outcome-only GRPO by 1.9 and 4.1 percentage points on the general-purpose and specialized backbones, respectively. It also improves performance on held-out categories and cross-platform scenarios for both backbones. Ablations further support the roles of real-time guidance and value gating. Our studies show that feedback from ongoing GUI interaction can provide effective fine-grained supervision beyond sparse task outcomes, offering a practical path toward online self-distillation for CUAs.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 ComputerSD，一种在线自蒸馏方法，它将来自 GUI 转换的实时反馈转化为 CUAs 的策略更新。 经过微调的 GUI 分析器会为每个执行的动作生成指导信息和步骤级的价值判断；指导信息提供特权上下文，而价值判断则对由此产生的词元级 OPSD 信号进行过滤。 ComputerSD 将这一目标与轨迹级的 GRPO 相结合，并在一个完全异步的框架中进行在线训练。 在 OSWorld-Verified 上，它在通用和专业骨干模型上的表现分别比仅基于结果的 GRPO 高出 1.9 和 4.1 个百分点。 它还在两个骨干模型的预留类别和跨平台场景中的性能得到了提升。 消融实验进一步验证了实时指导和价值过滤的作用。 我们的研究表明，来自持续 GUI 交互的反馈能够提供超越稀疏任务结果的精细监督，为 CUAs 的在线自蒸馏提供了一条实用路径。

paragraphs.en: ComputerSD relies on the reliability of the GUI analyzer, which provides both privileged guidance for self-distillation and step-level value judgments for gating the resulting supervision. Errors in either output can distort the OPSD signal, and the value gate cannot fully resolve this issue when both outputs are unreliable. Our design therefore balances feedback reliability against the cost of expert model calls: a fine-tuned GUI analyzer substantially reduces the cost of obtaining feedback while retaining strong reliability, as discussed in Appendix C.3 . Moreover, OPSD serves as an auxiliary objective alongside trajectory-level GRPO, with its contribution controlled by a small loss coefficient. This reduces the influence of occasional unreliable feedback on overall optimization, although systematic analyzer errors may still bias policy updates. Improving feedback reliability without substantially increasing inference cost remains an important direction for future work.
paragraphs.zh: ComputerSD 依赖于 GUI 分析器的可靠性，该分析器既为自蒸馏提供特权指导，也为门控最终产生的监督提供步骤级的价值判断。 任一输出的错误都可能扭曲 OPSD 信号；当两个输出都不可靠时，价值门无法完全解决这一问题。 因此，我们的设计在反馈可靠性与专家模型调用的成本之间取得了平衡：经过微调的 GUI 分析器显著降低了获取反馈的成本，同时保持了高可靠性，具体讨论见附录 C.3。 此外，OPSD 作为轨迹级 GRPO 的辅助目标发挥作用，其贡献度由一个较小的损失系数控制。 这减少了偶尔出现的不可靠反馈对整体优化的影响，尽管分析器的系统性错误仍可能对策略更新产生偏差。 在不显著增加推理成本的前提下提升反馈可靠性，仍然是未来研究的一个重要方向。

sents.zh: ComputerSD 依赖于 GUI 分析器的可靠性，该分析器既为自蒸馏提供特权指导，也为门控最终产生的监督提供步骤级的价值判断。

sents.en: Errors in either output can distort the OPSD signal, and the value gate cannot fully resolve this issue when both outputs are unreliable.
sents.zh: 任一输出的错误都可能扭曲 OPSD 信号；当两个输出都不可靠时，价值门无法完全解决这一问题。

sents.en: Our design therefore balances feedback reliability against the cost of expert model calls: a fine-tuned GUI analyzer substantially reduces the cost of obtaining feedback while retaining strong reliability, as discussed in Appendix C.3 .
sents.zh: 因此，我们的设计在反馈可靠性与专家模型调用的成本之间取得了平衡：经过微调的 GUI 分析器显著降低了获取反馈的成本，同时保持了高可靠性，具体讨论见附录 C.3。

sents.en: Moreover, OPSD serves as an auxiliary objective alongside trajectory-level GRPO, with its contribution controlled by a small loss coefficient.
sents.zh: 此外，OPSD 作为轨迹级 GRPO 的辅助目标发挥作用，其贡献度由一个较小的损失系数控制。

sents.en: This reduces the influence of occasional unreliable feedback on overall optimization, although systematic analyzer errors may still bias policy updates.
sents.zh: 这减少了偶尔出现的不可靠反馈对整体优化的影响，尽管分析器的系统性错误仍可能对策略更新产生偏差。

sents.en: Improving feedback reliability without substantially increasing inference cost remains an important direction for future work.
sents.zh: 在不显著增加推理成本的前提下提升反馈可靠性，仍然是未来研究的一个重要方向。

paragraphs.en: We fine-tune the GUI analyzer using LoRA with the ms-swift framework ( Zhao et al., 2024 ) . Table 7 summarizes the SFT hyperparameters. Data construction and expert annotation are detailed in Appendix C .
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 LoRA 和 ms-swift 框架（Zhao 等人，2024）对 GUI 分析器进行微调。 表 7 总结了 SFT 超参数。 数据构建和专家标注的详细信息见附录 C。

paragraphs.en: We use the slime framework ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) for online training with separate rollout and training engines. We perform full-parameter policy optimization while keeping the visual encoder frozen. Training tasks are shuffled before sampling. Policy rollouts use a temperature of 1.0, top- p p of 1.0, and a maximum response length of 1,024 tokens. Each step retains the three most recent historical screenshots in its context. The GUI analyzer uses a temperature of 0.0 and a maximum response length of 4,096 tokens. Table 7 lists the optimization hyperparameters.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 slime 框架（Zhu 等人，2025）进行在线训练，其中部署和训练引擎相互独立。 我们在保持视觉编码器冻结的同时，执行全参数策略优化。 在采样之前，训练任务会被打乱顺序。 策略部署使用温度为 1.0、top-p 为 1.0，且最大响应长度为 1,024 个词元。 每一步都会在其上下文中保留最近三个历史截图。 GUI 分析器使用温度为 0.0，且最大响应长度为 4,096 个词元。 表 7 列出了优化超参数。

paragraphs.en: Our fully asynchronous training framework is adapted from OpenClaw-RL Wang et al. (2026b) . Both ordinary and privileged contexts are rescored using the same snapshot of the current training policy. The resulting log-probability gaps and value-gate weights are computed once and cached. Updated parameters are synchronized to rollout workers immediately after each training step, while samples collected under earlier policy versions are retained. The SFT and online RL experiments each use one node equipped with 16 PPUs (96 GB). During online RL, the rollout and training engines each use 8 PPUs.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的完全异步训练框架改编自 OpenClaw-RL Wang 等人（2026b）的研究。 普通上下文和特权上下文均使用当前训练策略的同一快照进行重新评分。 由此产生的对数概率差异和价值门控权重会计算一次并缓存起来。 每次训练步骤结束后，更新后的参数会立即同步到 rollout 工作者，而先前策略版本下收集的样本则会保留。 SFT 和在线 RL 实验各使用一个配备 16 个 PPU（96 GB）的节点。 在线 RL 期间，rollout 引擎和训练引擎各使用 8 个 PPU。

paragraphs.en: We collect trajectories using Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking on 222 training tasks with a sampling temperature of 1.0. For each task, we sample eight trajectories, yielding 1,776 trajectories and 34,188 step-level samples. As summarized in Table 8 , successful and failed trajectories account for 43.4% and 56.6% of the collected trajectories, respectively. Among the annotated steps, 40.1% are judged correct by the expert model and 59.9% are judged incorrect.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking 在 222 个训练任务上收集轨迹，采样温度为 1.0。 对于每个任务，我们采样八条轨迹，共得到 1,776 条轨迹和 34,188 个步骤级样本。 如表 8 所示，成功和失败的轨迹分别占所收集轨迹的 43.4% 和 56.6%。 在已标注的步骤中，40.1% 被专家模型判定为正确，59.9% 被判定为错误。

sents.en: We collect trajectories using Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking on 222 training tasks with a sampling temperature of 1.0.
sents.zh: 我们使用 Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking 在 222 个训练任务上收集轨迹，采样温度为 1.0。

sents.en: For each task, we sample eight trajectories, yielding 1,776 trajectories and 34,188 step-level samples.

sents.zh: 如表 8 所示，成功和失败的轨迹分别占所收集轨迹的 43.4% 和 56.6%。

sents.en: Among the annotated steps, 40.1% are judged correct by the expert model and 59.9% are judged incorrect.
sents.zh: 在已标注的步骤中，40.1% 被专家模型判定为正确，59.9% 被判定为错误。

paragraphs.en: We use Kimi K3 ( Kimi Team et al., 2026 ) as the expert model to assess the value of each executed action and provide guidance, using the temperature of 1.0 and setting max_tokens to 2,048. Each annotation considers the task, the agent’s pre-action context and response, the executed action, and the post-action screenshot. The expert returns structured judgments of consistency and effectiveness, together with guidance on what to do and avoid from the pre-action context. Figure 9 presents the annotation prompt, and Table shows an example trajectory with step-level expert annotations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 Kimi K3（Kimi Team 等，2026）作为专家模型来评估每个执行动作的价值并提供指导，设置温度为 1.0，并将 max_tokens 设为 2,048。 每次标注都会考虑任务、智能体执行动作前的上下文与响应、已执行的动作以及执行动作后的屏幕截图。 专家会返回关于一致性和有效性的结构化判断，并结合执行动作前的上下文提供关于应做什么和应避免什么的具体指导。 图 9 展示了标注提示，表则展示了一个包含步骤级专家标注的示例轨迹。

paragraphs.en: We randomly hold out 1% of the annotated samples as a validation set, comprising 341 samples excluded from SFT. We compare the base Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking model with the fine-tuned GUI analyzer on agreement with the expert’s step-level value judgments and output format validity. The valid output rate measures the proportion of responses that satisfy the required format and can be parsed by our extraction rules.
paragraphs.zh: 我们随机保留 1% 的标注样本作为验证集，其中包含 341 个从 SFT 中排除的样本。 我们将基础模型 Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking 与经过微调的 GUI 分析器在是否与专家的步骤级价值判断一致以及输出格式有效性方面进行比较。 有效输出率衡量的是满足所需格式且能被我们的提取规则解析的响应所占的比例。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Table 9 , SFT increases expert agreement from 29.9% to 85.3% and the valid output rate from 41.6% to 99.7%. These results highlight the importance of task-specific fine-tuning for both value assessment and structured output generation. The fine-tuned analyzer provides more reliable supervision while avoiding expensive expert API calls during online training.
paragraphs.zh: 如表 9 所示，SFT 将专家一致率从 29.9% 提升至 85.3%，有效输出率则从 41.6% 提升至 99.7%。 这些结果凸显了针对特定任务进行微调在价值评估和结构化输出生成两方面的重要性。 经过微调的分析器能够提供更可靠的监督，同时避免了在线训练期间昂贵的专家 API 调用。

paragraphs.en: OSWorld-Verified ( Xie et al., 2024 ) is an interactive benchmark for evaluating agents on real-world computer tasks, including web browsing, document editing, file management, and workflows spanning multiple applications. Each task provides an initial environment configuration and an execution-based evaluator that checks task completion. Our experiments use 361 tasks, with 222 tasks used for online training and in-domain evaluation. The remaining 139 tasks from the Chrome and Multiple Apps categories are reserved for OOD evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: OSWorld-Verified（Xie 等人，2024）是一个交互式基准测试，用于评估智能体在执行真实世界计算机任务时的表现，包括网页浏览、文档编辑、文件管理以及跨多个应用程序的工作流。 每个任务都会提供一个初始的环境配置和一个基于执行的评估器，用于检查任务是否完成。 我们的实验使用了 361 个任务，其中 222 个任务用于在线训练和领域内评估。 来自 Chrome 和多个应用程序类别的其余 139 个任务则保留用于域外评估。

paragraphs.en: WindowsAgentArena ( Bonatti et al., 2024 ) evaluates computer-use agents in real Windows environments. The benchmark contains 154 tasks covering document editing, web browsing, system operations, coding, and multimedia applications, with task success assessed by execution-based evaluators. We use WindowsAgentArena for cross-platform evaluation of policies trained on OSWorld-Verified, without additional training on Windows tasks.
paragraphs.zh: WindowsAgentArena（Bonatti 等人，2024）在真实的 Windows 环境中评估计算机使用智能体。 该基准测试包含 154 项任务，涵盖文档编辑、网页浏览、系统操作、编程和多媒体应用，任务成功与否由基于执行的评估器进行判断。 我们使用 WindowsAgentArena 对基于 OSWorld-Verified 训练的策略进行跨平台评估，而无需在 Windows 任务上进行额外训练。

paragraphs.en: We compare ComputerSD with three baseline methods:
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 ComputerSD 与三种基线方法进行比较：

paragraphs.en: Prompt-only method. We use the expert model to generate trajectory-level guidance for each training task. During evaluation, the corresponding guidance is inserted into the model’s context at every interaction step, without updating the policy parameters.
paragraphs.zh: 仅提示方法。 我们使用专家模型为每个训练任务生成轨迹级别的指导。 在评估期间，相应的指导会在每次交互步骤中插入到模型上下文中，而不会更新策略参数。

paragraphs.en: Outcome-only GRPO. This baseline computes trajectory-level group-relative advantages using only the outcome rewards provided by the environment verifiers.

paragraphs.en: GRPO with PRM. This baseline uses the GUI analyzer as a process reward model, retaining only its step-level scores. We sum the scores over all steps in each trajectory and add the outcome reward to obtain a combined trajectory reward, which is then used to compute trajectory-level group-relative advantages.

paragraphs.en: We compare ComputerSD with two additional baselines, the prompt-only method and GRPO with PRM, using Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking as the base model to further examine the benefits of incorporating real-time guidance through online self-distillation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 ComputerSD 与另外两种基线方法进行了比较：仅使用提示词的方法以及结合 PRM 的 GRPO 方法，并使用 Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking 作为基础模型，以进一步探究通过在线自蒸馏引入实时指导所带来的优势。

paragraphs.en: Table 10 reports their performance on OSWorld-Verified. The prompt-only method improves the success rate from 33.8% to 34.6%, suggesting that injecting guidance into the context without updating the policy provides limited gains. GRPO with PRM achieves 37.4% but remains below ComputerSD at 39.8%. Although this baseline incorporates step-level value assessments, a scalar reward alone cannot fully exploit the real-time environment feedback.
paragraphs.zh: 表 10 报告了它们在 OSWorld-Verified 上的表现。 仅使用提示的方法将成功率从 33.8% 提高到了 34.6%，这表明在不更新策略的情况下向上下文中注入指导所带来的提升有限。 结合 PRM 的 GRPO 方法达到了 37.4%，但仍低于 ComputerSD 的 39.8%。 尽管这一基线方法包含了步骤级的价值评估，但仅凭标量奖励无法充分利用实时环境反馈。

paragraphs.en: After reaching the correct settings page, the GRPO-trained policy attempts to change the interval without first enabling the AutoRecovery checkbox. It then clicks OK and declares success though the input has not taken effect. In contrast, the ComputerSD-trained policy first enables the checkbox, then changes the interval and confirms the settings. This comparison suggests that ComputerSD internalizes a better understanding of task states from real-time feedback, rather than merely memorizing action sequences.
